hubs.en: a noun ending (not a word by itself here)

gaps.zh: 他的___很高，眼睛也很大。
gaps.en: His nose is high, and his eyes are big too.

gaps.zh: 我___饿了，现在想吃饭。
gaps.en: I am hungry and want to eat now.

gaps.zh: 我家有一个大___，里面有很多花。
gaps.en: My home has a big yard, and it has many flowers in it.

gaps.zh: 她在___里看自己的新衣服。
gaps.en: She looks at her new clothes in the mirror.

gaps.zh: 今天的饭___，我们再点一个菜吧。
gaps.en: The food is not enough today, so let us order one more dish.

gaps.zh: 你___来这么早，我们八点开始。
gaps.en: You do not need to come so early; we start at eight.

gaps.zh: 这件衣服很好看，___有点贵。
gaps.en: This piece of clothing looks nice, but it is a bit expensive.

gaps.zh: 走路___坐车快。
gaps.en: Walking is not as fast as taking a car.

gaps.zh: 爸爸下个月要___，一个星期才回来。
gaps.en: Dad will go on a business trip next month and will be back only after a week.

gaps.zh: 请走左边的___。
gaps.en: Please take the exit on the left.

gaps.zh: 这里有很多自行车可以___。
gaps.en: There are many bikes here that you can rent.

gaps.zh: 那个歌手今天晚上有___。
gaps.en: That singer has a performance this evening.

gaps.zh: 老师对学生很有___，从来不生气。
gaps.en: The teacher is very patient with students and never gets angry.

gaps.zh: 他写错了三个字，真___。
gaps.en: He wrote three characters wrong; he is really careless.

gaps.zh: 听到这个消息，她很___。
gaps.en: Hearing this news, she is very sad.

gaps.zh: 你要有___，一定能考好。
gaps.en: You must have confidence, and you can certainly do well on the exam.

hubs.en: to do; to make; to write

gaps.zh: 他是一位很有名的___，写了很多书。
gaps.en: He is a very famous writer and has written many books.

gaps.zh: 这本书的___是一位老师。
gaps.en: The author of this book is a teacher.

gaps.zh: 这个药很起___，我吃了就好了。
gaps.en: This medicine really works; I got better after taking it.

gaps.zh: 她跳舞的___很好看。
gaps.en: Her dance moves look very good.

gaps.zh: 我们今天要___，七点才能回家。
gaps.en: We must work overtime today and can only go home at seven.

gaps.zh: 我想___这个汉语班，我可以吗？
gaps.en: I want to join this Chinese class; can I?

gaps.zh: 比赛开始了，大家都在为我们的队___。
gaps.en: The match has started, and everyone is cheering for our team.

gaps.zh: 这个月我的工资___了。
gaps.en: My pay increased this month.

gaps.zh: 我的自行车坏了，我要去___一下。
gaps.en: My bike is broken, and I will go and get it repaired.

gaps.zh: 你的房间太乱了，快去___吧。
gaps.en: Your room is too messy; go and tidy it quickly.

gaps.zh: 他去店里___了，头发短了很多。
gaps.en: He went to the shop for a haircut, and his hair is much shorter.

gaps.zh: 她的___是当一名老师。
gaps.en: Her ideal is to become a teacher.

gaps.zh: 这个城市在中国的___，冬天很冷，常常下雪。
gaps.en: This city is in the north of China; winters are cold and it often snows.

gaps.zh: 这个___的人都很忙。
gaps.en: The people in this department are all very busy.

gaps.zh: 我只做完了___作业，还有一些没做完。
gaps.en: I have only finished part of the homework, and some is not done.

gaps.zh: 书里的故事我___看完了。
gaps.en: I have read all the stories in the book.

gaps.zh: 我每天七点吃___，然后去上班。
gaps.en: I eat breakfast at seven every day and then go to work.

gaps.zh: 十二点半是我们的___时间。
gaps.en: Half past twelve is our lunch time.

gaps.zh: 这家___的菜很好吃，价格也不贵。
gaps.en: The dishes at this restaurant are delicious, and the prices are not high either.

gaps.zh: 同事们星期五晚上一起___，大家都很高兴。
gaps.en: The colleagues have a meal together on Friday evening, and everyone is very happy.

gaps.zh: 老师每天上课先___，看看谁没来。
gaps.en: The teacher takes the roll first in every class to see who has not come.

gaps.zh: 他听了我的话，对我___笑了笑。
gaps.en: He heard what I said, nodded at me and smiled.

gaps.zh: 这个城市有很多有名的___。
gaps.en: This city has many famous scenic spots.

gaps.zh: 这个手机最大的___是很便宜。
gaps.en: The biggest strength of this phone is that it is cheap.

gaps.zh: 对这个问题，你有什么___？
gaps.en: What is your view on this problem?

gaps.zh: 他的手机坏了，所以___给我打电话。
gaps.en: His phone is broken, so he cannot call me.

gaps.zh: 我有一个新___，你想听吗？
gaps.en: I have a new idea; do you want to hear it?

gaps.zh: 开车的时候不能打电话，这是___。
gaps.en: You cannot make phone calls while driving; this is the law.

gaps.zh: 我喜欢听奶奶说她的___。
gaps.en: I like listening to Grandma talk about her childhood.

gaps.zh: 他是一位___人，在公司工作。
gaps.en: He is a middle-aged man who works at a company.

gaps.zh: ___的时候，我们公司会很忙。
gaps.en: At the end of the year, our company will be very busy.

gaps.zh: 你的___是多少？
gaps.en: What is your age?

gaps.zh: 你帮了我这么多，真是太___你了。
gaps.en: You have helped me so much; I really thank you.

gaps.zh: 这个电影的故事很___，我看哭了。
gaps.en: The story of this film is very moving, and it made me cry.

gaps.zh: 听了他的话，我很___。
gaps.en: After hearing his words, I was very moved.

gaps.zh: 我___今天会下雨，你带伞了吗？
gaps.en: I feel it will rain today; did you bring an umbrella?

gaps.zh: 我给朋友发了一条___，他马上回复了。
gaps.en: I sent my friend a text message, and he replied right away.

gaps.zh: 这里手机___不好，我打不了电话。
gaps.en: The phone signal here is not good, so I cannot make calls.

gaps.zh: 他很___，说话时一点也不紧张。
gaps.en: He is very confident and is not nervous at all when he speaks.

gaps.zh: 我在网上找到了很多有用的___。
gaps.en: I found a lot of useful information on the Internet.

gaps.zh: 今天的___很高，太热了。
gaps.en: The temperature today is very high; it is too hot.

gaps.zh: 明天会___，你要多穿一点衣服。
gaps.en: It will get colder tomorrow; you must wear more clothes.

gaps.zh: 我的___很正常，不用担心。
gaps.en: My body temperature is normal, so there is no need to worry.

gaps.zh: 这个房间的___太低了，有点冷。
gaps.en: The temperature of this room is too low, so it is a bit cold.

gaps.zh: 这次考试我的___很高。
gaps.en: My score on this exam is high.

gaps.zh: 来参加活动的___不多，只有十个人。
gaps.en: The number of people coming to the event is not large; there are only ten.

gaps.zh: ___学生都喜欢这位老师。
gaps.en: Most students like this teacher.

gaps.zh: 请把电话号码上的___写清楚。
gaps.en: Please write the numbers in the phone number clearly.

gaps.zh: 这件衣服的___是两百块。
gaps.en: The price of this piece of clothing is 200 yuan.

gaps.zh: 今天很多东西都___了，我买了三件。
gaps.en: Many things have dropped in price today, and I bought three.

gaps.zh: 他用___买到了一辆很好的车，真便宜。
gaps.en: He bought a very good car at a low price; it was really cheap.

gaps.zh: 这件衣服的___是多少？
gaps.en: What is the price of this piece of clothing?

gaps.zh: 这家餐厅的茶是___的，可以随便喝。
gaps.en: The tea at this restaurant is free, and you can drink as much as you like.

gaps.zh: 请不要___水，我们要保护大自然。
gaps.en: Please do not waste water; we must protect nature.

gaps.zh: 这个学校的___不高，一年五千块。
gaps.en: The tuition at this school is not high: 5,000 yuan a year.

gaps.zh: 这条高速公路___，每辆车二十块。
gaps.en: This highway charges a fee: 20 yuan for each car.

gaps.zh: 那位___在电影里演一位老师。
gaps.en: That actor plays a teacher in the film.

gaps.zh: 我们球队有十五名___。
gaps.en: Our team has fifteen members.

gaps.zh: 我是这家书店的___，买书可以打折。
gaps.en: I am a member of this bookshop, and I can get a discount when I buy books.

gaps.zh: 公司的___都在开会。
gaps.en: The staff of the company are all in a meeting.

gaps.zh: 这家餐厅的___做的菜很好吃。
gaps.en: The chef of this restaurant makes delicious dishes.

gaps.zh: 他是一名___，帮人解决法律问题。
gaps.en: He is a lawyer who helps people solve legal problems.

gaps.zh: 她是学校的___，教汉语。
gaps.en: She is a teacher at the school and teaches Chinese.

gaps.zh: 这个班的___关系很好。
gaps.en: The relationship between teachers and students in this class is very good.

gaps.zh: 路上现在___了，我们可能会迟到。
gaps.en: There is a traffic jam on the road now, so we will probably be late.

gaps.zh: 这里不能___，请去那边。
gaps.en: You cannot park here; please go over there.

gaps.zh: 坐___去很快，两个小时就到。
gaps.en: Going by high-speed train is fast; it takes only two hours to arrive.

gaps.zh: 高速公路上的___不能太快。
gaps.en: The speed on the highway cannot be too fast.

gaps.zh: 公共汽车上的___很多，现在没有座位了。
gaps.en: There are many passengers on the bus, and there are no seats now.

gaps.zh: 这家商店的___很多，每天都很忙。
gaps.en: This shop has many customers and is busy every day.

gaps.zh: 请到___坐，我去给你拿水。
gaps.en: Please sit in the living room; I am going to get you some water.

gaps.zh: 你不用___，请随便坐。
gaps.en: You do not need to be polite; please sit wherever you like.

gaps.zh: 明天要考试，___们都在认真复习。
gaps.en: There will be an exam tomorrow, and the candidates are all studying seriously.

gaps.zh: 他的___很不容易，经历了很多事。
gaps.en: His life is not easy; he has experienced many things.

gaps.zh: 小狗的___也很重要，我们要好好照顾它。
gaps.en: A little dog's life matters too, so we must look after it well.

gaps.zh: 你要注意个人___，每天洗手。
gaps.en: You must pay attention to personal hygiene and wash your hands every day.

gaps.zh: 他喜欢___，一个人在家学汉语。
gaps.en: He likes teaching himself and studies Chinese alone at home.

gaps.zh: 他今年九月要___，很高兴。
gaps.en: He will start school in September this year and is very happy.

gaps.zh: 他对___很有兴趣，常常看这方面的书。
gaps.en: He is very interested in science and often reads books on this subject.

gaps.zh: 这位老师的___方法很特别，学生们都很喜欢。
gaps.en: This teacher's teaching method is special, and the students all like it.

gaps.zh: 我肚子饿了，想吃一点___。
gaps.en: I am hungry now and want to eat some snacks.

gaps.zh: 学校的___里有很多好吃的菜。
gaps.en: The school canteen has many delicious dishes.

gaps.zh: 这个城市有很多有名的___。
gaps.en: This city has many famous delicacies.

gaps.zh: 小狗吃的是什么___？
gaps.en: What kind of food does the little dog eat?

gaps.zh: 我们学校的___很好。
gaps.en: Our school's team is very good.

gaps.zh: 她每天下午和朋友打___。
gaps.en: She plays volleyball with her friends every afternoon.

gaps.zh: ___是我们的家，我们要保护它。
gaps.en: The Earth is our home, and we must protect it.

gaps.zh: 看比赛的___都很兴奋。
gaps.en: The fans watching the match are all very excited.

gaps.zh: 老师___我们明天要考试。
gaps.en: The teacher reminds us that we will have an exam tomorrow.

gaps.zh: 这家酒店为客人___免费早餐。
gaps.en: This hotel provides free breakfast for its guests.

gaps.zh: 比赛八点开始，你最好___到。
gaps.en: The match begins at eight; you had better arrive early.

gaps.zh: 他在开会时___了一个好办法。
gaps.en: At the meeting he put forward a good method.

gaps.zh: 对不起，我想向你___。
gaps.en: I am sorry; I want to apologise to you.

gaps.zh: 这条___很干净，也很安静。
gaps.en: This street is very clean and also quiet.

gaps.zh: 这个菜的___很好，我还想吃。
gaps.en: This dish tastes good, and I still want to eat.

gaps.zh: 这里的___很好，开车很方便。
gaps.en: The roads here are good, and driving is very convenient.

gaps.zh: 朋友之间要___帮助。
gaps.en: Friends must help each other.

gaps.zh: 我的想法和你的___，我不同意。
gaps.en: My idea is the opposite of yours, and I do not agree.

gaps.zh: 这两本书的价格___，都是五十块。
gaps.en: The prices of these two books are the same: both are 50 yuan.

gaps.zh: 和去年___，今年的雨少了。
gaps.en: Compared with last year, this year has less rain.

gaps.zh: 跑了五公里，我已经没有___了。
gaps.en: After running five kilometres, I have no strength left.

gaps.zh: 他工作___很强，大家都很喜欢他。
gaps.en: He is very capable at work, and everyone likes him very much.

gaps.zh: 汉语考试有___和阅读两个部分。
gaps.en: The Chinese exam has two parts: listening and reading.

gaps.zh: 最近工作很多，我的___很大。
gaps.en: Recently there is a lot of work, and I am under great pressure.

gaps.zh: 这个城市的___很方便。
gaps.en: The transport in this city is very convenient.

gaps.zh: 这只是一个___的手机，不贵。
gaps.en: This is only an ordinary phone, and it is not expensive.

gaps.zh: 学校___我们明天不上课。
gaps.en: The school has notified us that there is no class tomorrow.

gaps.zh: 我___了考试，真高兴。
gaps.en: I passed the exam, and I am really happy.

gaps.zh: 我喜欢___，不用出门。
gaps.en: I like shopping online and do not need to go out.

gaps.zh: 请把这个___发给我。
gaps.en: Please send me this web address.

gaps.zh: 这个___很慢，我等了很久。
gaps.en: This web page is slow, and I waited a long time.

gaps.zh: 她是我的___，我们没见过面。
gaps.en: She is my online friend, and we have never met.

gaps.zh: 他的汉语说得很___。
gaps.en: He speaks Chinese very fluently.

gaps.zh: 现在这种帽子很___。
gaps.en: This kind of hat is popular now.

gaps.zh: 我们用汉语___吧。
gaps.en: Let us communicate in Chinese.

gaps.zh: 他有很多工作___。
gaps.en: He has a lot of work experience.

gaps.zh: 这个国家的___越来越好。
gaps.en: This country's economy is getting better and better.

gaps.zh: 这是一次特别的___。
gaps.en: This is a special experience.

gaps.zh: 我___六点起床。
gaps.en: I usually get up at six.

gaps.zh: 一切都很___，不用担心。
gaps.en: Everything is normal, so there is no need to worry.

gaps.zh: 这是他的___生活。
gaps.en: This is his daily life.

gaps.zh: 我家___有一家银行。
gaps.en: There is a bank opposite my home.

gaps.zh: 他在很多___都很好。
gaps.en: He is good in many respects.

gaps.zh: 明天我要去___，有点紧张。
gaps.en: I will go to an interview tomorrow, and I am a bit nervous.

gaps.zh: 我们要勇敢地___困难。
gaps.en: We must face difficulties bravely.

gaps.zh: 他遇到了很多___。
gaps.en: He has run into many difficulties.

gaps.zh: 我肚子疼，很___。
gaps.en: My stomach hurts, and I feel very bad.

gaps.zh: 那次旅行真让人___。
gaps.en: That trip is really unforgettable.

gaps.zh: ___你不知道吗？
gaps.en: Do you really not know?

opps.note: 优点 is a good point and 缺点 is a point that is lacking. Both end in 点 (point).
High and low temperature. Both end in 温 (temperature), and 高 and 低 are high and low.
A high price and a low price. 价 is price.
To increase and to decrease. 增加 means to add more and 减少 means to make less.
The way in and the way out. 口 is an opening: 入 goes in and 出 comes out.
To succeed and to fail.
Correct and wrong.
To agree to something and to refuse it.
To support and to oppose. 反 means against.
Tense and relaxed. 紧 is tight and 轻 is light.
Earlier than planned and later than planned. 提前 moves it forward and 推迟 pushes it back.
The southern part and the northern part. Both end in 部 (part).
The eastern part and the western part.
Father and mother. Both end in 亲 (parent).
Male and female. 性 marks the sex.
Breakfast and dinner. 早 is early and 晚 is late.
To waste and to save.
Free of charge and charged for. 免 means to be spared and 收 means to take in.
Careful and careless. Both end in 心 (heart): 细 is fine and 粗 is rough.
The same and the opposite. Both start with 相.
Boring and interesting. 无 means without and 有 means to have.
Strict and casual.
The majority and the minority. 多 is many and 少 is few.
A large amount and a small amount.
Light and heavy.
A benefit and a harm. Both end in 处 (place, point).
To praise and to criticise.
To grow and to fall. Both are used for numbers.
To win and to lose.
Young adulthood and old age. Both end in 年 (years).
To finish school and to start school.
For a short time and for ever.
Lower than and higher than.
Full and empty.
All of it and only a part of it.
